addresses.name: CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions
addresses.signature: void __thiscall CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions(CAIUnit* this, void* units, CList* records, bool anyLandUnit, bool withAllies)
addresses.comment:
Fills a position list's have (+0x10) and standing (+0x14). 0x4D9E30, two `ret 0x10`. For each land unit of the vector (divisions only unless anyLandUnit), not retreating or retreating with an organisation share >= 0.5: the records are walked in list order - the first that is its province counts it standing and heading (have and standing +1) unless it is bound for a province not held by an enemy, when it is counted nowhere; the first that is its destination (GetMovementDestinationProvince) counts it heading. With withAllies, focus areas (+0x340 > 0) and the frontier at war, it recurses over the whole unit list of every non-hostile country other than us that controls a focus area's first province. Callers: CAIUnit_FillLinePositions, CAIUnit_FillGarrisons, CAIUnit_PlaceReserves and itself. The name is ours. Who passes what, on the listing (2026-11-10): CAIUnit_FillLinePositions passes +0x12C, every committed division **garrisons included**, divisions only, with allies; CAIUnit_FillGarrisons its garrison divisions and any land unit, no allies; CAIUnit_PlaceReserves +0x15C, any land unit, no allies. A unit standing in a record whose destination is not held by an enemy (CCountry::IsEnemy) is counted nowhere. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 13.

**The allies' half, read on the listing 2026-11-10** (`FINDINGS-liveread.md`, section 21). With withAllies, focus areas (+0x340 > 0) and the frontier at war (+0x364): for each country on the agent's country's non_hostile_countries (+0xF98) but itself, the focus areas (+0x338) are walked, and at the first whose first province that country controls, the country's whole unit list (+0xBAC) is copied to a vector and this function called over it with the same records and anyLandUnit, withAllies false. Once a country. An area with no provinces answers the tag `---` and id 0. The enemy test on a unit's destination stays the agent's country's.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_SplitGarrisonAndLine
addresses.signature: void __stdcall CAIUnit_SplitGarrisonAndLine(CAIUnit* agent, CList* positions, void* garrisonDivisions, CList* garrisonTargets, int* garrisonCount, int* lineCount)
addresses.comment:
0x4C7AB0 to the `ret 0x18` at 0x4C8EA5, read whole. (1) **Garrison divisions**: over +0x13C, a division with a brigade of type garrison_brigade (CSubUnitDataBase +0x50) gets CUnit +0x2C9 (ai_garrison) = 1 and goes into the output vector; one without, already flagged, stays only while it stands in land we control and is not a role-8 army with air transports about (+0x10C), else its flag is cleared. (2) **Garrison targets**: the hold list +0x17C (slot 80's, best first) - a record of score >= 20.0 in land we control goes onto `garrisonTargets` by descending score, unless it is an ops-area province of under 10 victory points that is not its own depot; for the human's delegated AI (runs_units clear) a province holding a friendly land unit of another agent is skipped; strong = records of score >= 50.0. (3) **The counts**, n = |+0x13C|, posCap = 10 x |positions|: no positions -> garrison = n; no hold provinces (+0x184 == 0) -> line = n - |garrison-brigade divisions|; else front = |+0xC0|, enemies = non-friend land units on front provinces whose controller IsFrontWorthyEnemy, areaSum = the sum of those provinces' areas' sizes; at war on the frontier (+0x364) front x2, front = max(front, areaSum < 7 ? 2 x enemies : enemies), strong = 1 when front <= enemies/3 and strong > 1, enemies x2; lineWant = min(max(enemies, front), posCap); garrison = min(min(+0x184, n), n - lineWant), raised to min(max(targets, |garrison-brigade divisions|) capped at n, n - front) when below that, then to strong; line = n - garrison, the excess over posCap handed back to the garrison. In a scenario game (gamestate +0xD0C) nine tenths of the garrison go to the line. (4) The targets are topped up from the rest of the hold list (any score, best first) until there are `garrison` of them. (5) Per region group (COwnerArea +0x6C) of the first `garrison` targets - the shortfall added to the theatre's largest area's group - the garrison divisions standing or heading there are cut to the group's count (dropping first the one without militia (+1000) or police (+500) whose hold score is lowest; garrison-brigade divisions never) and raised to it from divisions of +0x13C not flagged, standing or heading in the group, facing no country we prepare war on, and at war carrying no armour, light armour, heavy armour or mechanized brigade, nor paratroopers while air transports exist - the best by (10 x its garrison rating (slot 88, RateUnitAsGarrison) + (mean distance to the ops area + 10)/5) x 0.75 on a front province x (1.5 - its organisation share); each pick gets +0x2C9 = 1. The name is ours. See FINDINGS-moving.md, section A.3. On the listing, 2026-11-10: the area sum adds the area's size once for **every** front-worthy front province, whether or not its area has been seen and whether or not it holds a unit - the list of areas it builds is never read. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 14.

**Read again on the listing, 2026-11-10** (`FINDINGS-liveread.md`, section 21). The targets go in through CList_InsertByDescendingScore in both rounds, so the list is in descending score whichever round found a target; of equals the earlier stays first. Which unit is marked: in the block by the area group of where it stands **or** of its destination; the neighbours looked at for a prepared war are its destination's, or where it stands with none; the armour test is the **agent's** frontier at war (+0x364), not the country's war, so an agent away from the fighting takes armour for a garrison. Not built in OpenHOI3 and not settled: where CEU3AI +0x2C is clear, a hold province with a friendly unit whose topmost agent up the parents (+0x1E0, +0x198) is another agent is left out of the targets; that byte read 1 on the Soviet Union on the save of July 1941.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_FillGarrisons
addresses.signature: bool __stdcall CAIUnit_FillGarrisons(CAIUnit* agent, void* garrisonDivisions, CList* garrisonTargets, int garrisonCount)
addresses.comment:
0x4CACB0 to the `ret 0x10` at 0x4CB7FD. Candidates are the garrison divisions, plus - when the agent's country is the one played - every division of it with no agent above it. CAIUnit::CountUnitsAtPositions(candidates, targets, any land unit, no allies). Each target in list order wants |garrisonDivisions| / |targets|, the first remainder ones one more; a threatened province (+0x1DC) adds the brigades of the hostile land units heading into it (CollectUnitsMovingIntoProvince with enemiesOnly); the want is held to the stack cap, round(0.5 / (-BASE_STACKING_PENALTY)) (20 where that is not above nought). While have < want: the candidate not in a battle, not retreating, free to leave (UnitMayLeave strict), standing or heading in the target's area (or anywhere, where the target's area is one of the focus areas +0x338), not already there, not in a threatened province, and - unless the target is threatened - not taken from a hold position whose standing less one (none where that position scores less or the target is a depot) is no more than the target's have plus one for a non-depot, nearest by squared map distance (x 2 for an army of role 5 leaving a higher-scored position) and able to reach it, is moved there (MoveUnit 0, 1, 1). The name is ours. **Read again on the listing, 2026-11-10, with the candidate test in full.** Each target wants the number of garrison divisions (the vector, not the split's count) over the targets. A candidate is judged by where it is bound, or where it stands with no destination: that province must be in the target's area (or the target's area a focus area), not the target, not held by a country it is at war with or by the rebels or under an undeclared war, and not threatened. Unless the target is threatened, where that province is itself a target of this list with a score above nought: it is passed over when have(target) + (1, none at a depot) >= standing(there) - (1, none where the target scores more or is a depot). The distance is squared x 16 in single precision, doubled for an army of role 5 where that province scores more than the target (and the target is not threatened); least first, a tie to the earlier unit, and only one that can reach the target. The pick takes one off have where it was bound for a target, or off have and standing where it stood in one with no destination; it is counted as sent whatever MoveUnit answers. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 13.

**The distance is from where the candidate is bound** (or stands with none), the same province its tests are of (`FINDINGS-liveread.md`, section 21): esi at 0x4CB369 is still that province at 0x4CB4F8.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_ManageLandUnits
addresses.comment:
**The land half of CAIUnit slot 73**, the third body it calls after CAIUnit_ManageAirUnits (0x4CD890) and CAIUnit_ManageNavalUnits (0x4D0880). Extent 0x4D57F0-0x4D7F7E, 10126 bytes, 2768 instructions, read end to end by walking every branch; two `ret 4` at 0x4D7F5B and 0x4D7F7B, both in the epilogue, so trap 3 does not apply. int3 x16 before it, int3 x2 and a fresh SEH prologue at 0x4D7F80 after. Trap 2: functionStart is wrong inside it twice (functionStart(0x4D6B45)=0x4D653C, functionStart(0x4D7D00)=0x4D78FB), both isolated 0xCC bytes. One dead 5-byte `jmp`+nop at 0x4D613B. One caller, slot 73 at 0x4B0D01: unconditional when the daily-stagger flag is set, otherwise one pass in three and only when at_war, in_undeclared_war or CCountry +0xF50 > 0. Return value set at exactly one place (0x4D7AB3) and never read.

ENTRY GATE: the topmost-agent test, then the +0x12C vector must hold at least one element, then **agent->+0x364 (frontier at a shooting war) and +0x366 must both be set** - so the whole function is dead for an agent whose operations area does not border an active war.

PHASE 1 (0x4D5944-0x4D678D) scores every enemy-controlled province of agent->front_provinces (+0xC0) into a fresh CProvinceFloat {vftable 0x15EB644, 0x18D, province id, float} inserted score-descending through 0x49C330. Base weight is a 0..500 ramp on map distance from the ops area's supply depot (flat 100.0 in arcade mode), x2 in an owner area of under 3 provinces, + half each enemy neighbour's plan-objective priority, + (operable land neighbours - 1) x 50 (x20 at stance 3, x10 at stance 4), +1000 for being on agent->+0x1BC and +500 for touching it, + 5*navalBase.level_max+100. At plan stance 3 or 4 only it also adds the province's own objective priority, 90 per plan-path province it is and 45 per one it touches (for both CUnit +0x244 and +0x258), 1000 when every operable neighbour is in agent->+0x1CC, **and agent->front_province_scores (+0x294)[province] through AIOrderedMap_SubscriptFloat at 0x4D5F6B - the single instruction that consumes CAIUnit::RebuildFrontAndApproaches's output, and its only reader in the image**; plus 125/250 for a thin enemy salient and 200/400 for a split approach, and x0.25/x0.5 for a redundant pocket approach (dropped outright below stance 3).

PHASE 2 (0x4D6795-0x4D7CB9) walks the targets best first. A score of 500 or more promotes the local stance to 4. Candidate units are the agent's own leaf land units (slot 15) standing in the target's friendly neighbours, filtered on fuel, ai_held_back, slot 86, combat state and pending destination; each is scored enemyNeighbours*10 - slot89(target,unit)*10 (+100 when slot88 > 95, /10 when it belongs to another agent, /5 when it has a blocking order) into **CUnit +0x2B8**, with the number of garrisoned unattacked enemy neighbours in **CUnit +0x2BC**. **The candidates are kept in ascending order of that score** - each goes in before the first candidate scoring more (0x4D7182 `ja`, CList_InsertBefore at 0x4D71CB), ties after - **and are added lowest first**, so the score is a cost: a unit whose own province has fewer enemy neighbours, and whose terrain attack+movement modifier at the target's terrain (slot 89, CAIUnit::GetUnitTerrainModifier with attacking=1) is higher, is tried first, and a unit rated a garrison above 95 (slot 88, CAIUnit::RateUnitAsGarrison) is pushed to the back. Slot 86 (CAIUnit::IsUnitReservedForTransport) is asked again of each candidate in the commit loop (0x4D7579), as well as in the candidate filter (0x4D6DAD) and of the stand-in (0x4D7768). Units are added while 0x4D93B0's odds figure does not fall; the attack goes ahead when the figure reaches 3.0 (1.1 at stance 4, 5.0 at stance 2 for admitting more units) and at least one attacker is movable, and is called off below 0.8 - both bars collapsing to 0.2/0.01 when the target borders two or more region groups or when an attacker is unsupplied and the target has a port. **A unit that cannot be spared from its own province gets `support_attack` (0x4D7AD6); every other one gets CEU3AI::MoveUnit (0x4D7AAE).**

PHASE 3 (0x4D7CBF-0x4D7F2C) sweeps agent->+0x11C's CUnit vector and stands down units whose attack is going badly - the combat's slot 17 (CCombat::GetAttackerStrengthShare, the attacker's share in thousandths) over 0.5 when the unit is on the defending side - i.e. its side is losing, the same sense as the naval body's complemented test, or a `support_attack` whose whole attacking side is pinned - but never one whose destination is on agent->+0x1BC. Standing down is CUnit::AIStandDown (0x49AAB0): a CSetOrderCommand for a null order where the order is not already null, the unit's movement_destination_province_id zeroed on the spot, and a CCancelMovementCommand - the unit halts in the province it stands in; nothing marches it back.

**Phase 3, the calling off, read again 2026-11-10** (`FINDINGS-liveread.md`, section 20): a land battle always answers that it may be left, so a unit falling back is called off a losing defence too; a support attacker (order type 0x4E5) is stood down when every attacker of its battle answers order slot 24, which a plain move and no order do not.
